page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor. The instance features 16 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance includes 893 GB of bundled local SSD storage. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

The underlying Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor does not support hyperthreading on this instance, meaning each of the 16 vCPUs maps to a dedicated physical core. Additionally, the CPU flags indicate a lack of support for advanced instruction sets such as AVX, AVX-512, AMX, AES cryptography, and SHA extensions. This limits its efficiency for workloads requiring hardware-accelerated encryption or vector math.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i1.4xlarge offers a balanced resource density of compute and local SSD storage. It is suitable for general-purpose workloads, relational databases, and local file processing tasks that benefit from dedicated physical cores and local SSD storage but do not require modern vector or cryptographic CPU instructions.
